posts.text:
U.S.-Iran peace talks are messy and may fail. But if they produce a deal, it could prove more durable than the JCPOA. Unlike the 2015 agreement, this deal is emerging out of a war, with Republicans on the U.S. side and hardliners on the Iranian side owning the process rather than opposing it.

On @Channel4News + @krishgm

posts.text:
War with Iran was not a cakewalk.

Iran can’t outmatch the U.S. and Israel militarily. But its leverage comes from asymmetric capabilities, escalation across multiple fronts, and its geographic advantage over the Strait of Hormuz.

That’s what many underestimated.

Iran’s Axis of Resistance Under Fire
